name: TumorHope2_search_peptides
description: Search TumorHoPe 2 (Raghava lab, IIITD) for TUMOR-HOMING peptide records used in drug delivery. Filter by 'source' (peptide source label, e.g. A33H), 'target_tumor' (e.g. 'Brain tumor'), 'name_source', or 'conjugate'. Each record returns the peptide sequence, target tumor / cell, receptor / biomarker, N/C-terminus modifications, sequence motif, phage-display origin, in-vitro and in-vivo evidence, conjugate, PubMed ID, year, and title. Note: this API does not support sequence search. Keyless public API.

source.description: Peptide source label. Example: 'A33H' -> 1 record (SIWV, a brain-tumor-homing tetrapeptide).

target_tumor.description: Target tumor type. Example: 'Brain tumor' -> ~39 records.

conjugate.description: Conjugate / payload label (e.g. a fluorophore or nanoparticle).

id.description: The database's own identifier for the peptide entry.

sequence.description: The amino-acid sequence in one-letter code.

source.description: The source the entry was taken from.

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the paper reporting it.

refrence.description: The reference as the database spells it (the misspelling is upstream's).

patent.description: Patent covering the peptide, where one is recorded.

target_tumor.description: The tumour type the peptide targets.

target_cell.description: The cell type or line it was shown to bind.

homing.description: The tissue or tumour the peptide homes to -- the claim this database records.

receptors_biomarker.description: The receptor or biomarker it binds, where identified. Without it a homing claim has no mechanism.

motif.description: The binding motif within the sequence.

conjugate.description: What the peptide was conjugated to when tested -- a dye, a drug, a nanoparticle. Homing shown with one conjugate may not hold with another.

phage_display.description: Whether the peptide came from a phage-display screen. A screen hit is a starting point, not a validated binder.

invivo.description: What was shown in vivo. An in vitro-only entry has not been shown to home in an animal.

name_source.description: Where the peptide's name comes from.

oneOf.description: Matching tumor-homing peptide records. Each has id, title, pmid, year, source, name_source, sequence, n_term, c_term, motif, target_tumor, target_cell, receptors_biomarker, phage_display, invitro, invivo.
